Subject: HealthSpark: Security intake & SIG activation — clarifying evidence and next steps

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Current asks from HealthSpark: SOC 2 status, data residency options, HIPAA compliance posture, and completion of your SIG/CAIQ for vendor onboarding.
- From our side: we can provide a concise SOC 2 summary (scope + auditor + date) immediately and the SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA if required; we also have a SIG prefill worksheet we can use to accelerate your review.

Clarifying questions for you so we prioritize correctly:
1) Do you require the full SOC 2 Type II report for initial eval, or is a one-page SOC 2 cover letter + Trust Services summary sufficient to advance to procurement?
2) For the SIG: do you want the full SIG PDF returned, or are you open to a prefilled spreadsheet (we can export answers into your SIG)?
3) Any specific evidence you need up front (e.g., encryption config screenshots, network diagrams, or KMS certs)?

Proposed next steps:
- I will attach our SOC 2 summary and the SIG-prefill template.
- Kimberly / Soojin, could you prepare the SOC 2 cover + a short data-residency statement (US multi-region) and a list of ownerable evidence items?
- Sarah, if you confirm the preferred SIG workflow I’ll queue the prefill and target to return completed responses within 3 business days.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this across the line.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
M: (415) 555-0198

Attachments referenced: Redwood-SOC2-Summary.pdf; SIG-prefill-template.xlsx
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@healthspark.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-05T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HealthSpark: Security intake & SIG activation — clarifying evidence and next steps

Connor — thanks for the summary and the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side:

- For our security review board, we usually ask for the full SOC 2 Type II report when a vendor will handle PHI. Since we are exploring HIPAA scope, please mark if any of your hosted products are covered (and which ones). If you can’t share the full report immediately, the SOC 2 cover letter + testing period and auditor name will help us get to procurement faster.

- SIG workflow: we prefer the prefilled spreadsheet to speed internal review; if you can return answers in SIG Excel and also attach screenshots for any control where you reference evidence that would be ideal.

- Evidence: the most common critical asks from our reviewers are: encryption-in-transit config, key management ownership (KMS/HSM vendor), data retention policy, and a network diagram showing egress paths. If you can flag which of those are publicly shareable vs. NDA-only, that helps.

Procurement is copied on this thread (procurement@healthspark.io) — they’ll be the signature authority. Also: can you propose a tentative timeline for SOC2 evidence + completed SIG spreadsheet? We’d like the vendor packet within 5 business days if possible.

Thanks,
Sarah Lee
Head of Security & Compliance
HealthSpark
